items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the R-universality criterion for the even special orthogonal algebra (author prop at source lines 673-682, label so2k), phrased through the even Clifford algebra and the sign or square condition on the determinant. The proof (source lines 684-712) computes the Tits algebras of the three character-group generators, identifies the relevant one with the even Clifford algebra over the quadratic extension, and then reads the two alternatives off the author's division-algebra description of R-universality; the inner and outer cases are separated by the square condition on the determinant (proof lines 687-711). The case distinction and the Clifford-algebra computation are the substance of the proof. H2.
